# Create Variables

Source : https://learn.sweego.io/docs/templates/variables

> You can define variables to personalize your emails.

You can define variables to personalize your emails.

Variables can be defined directly via API, or you can define them within the App.
The benefit of defining variables in the App is to easily identify which variables to use for specific email sends, for example.
This ensures that when sending your email, you don't forget to fill in these variables.

**Creating Variables**

To create a variable, follow these steps:

- Navigate to the variables section in the App.

![template variable](undefined)

- Click on "Variables".

![create variable](undefined)

Create your variable and save it.

**Tip:**

**Always use descriptive names for variables. This helps in easily identifying them, especially if you need to use the variable weeks after its creation or if multiple team members are working on the project.**

![variable creation](undefined)

Your variables are now visible here.
You can delete them or create new ones at any time.

![teamplate list](undefined)
